text: Ɓee ɗoo -wano Al-Najashi e wonndiiɓe mun, ɓerɗe maɓɓe no newii, tawde hiɓe fesa tuma ɓe nani kon ko Jippinaa ko Qur'aanaare, e sabu ko ɓe anndi kon goonga kan ka Iisaa (yo o his) addi, hiɓe wi'a: "Joomi amen, men gomɗinii kon ko Jippin Ɗaa e Nulaaɗo Maa on Muhammadu (jom-kisiyee), Winndidu men e mofte Muhammadu ɗen Ñalnde Darngal, men wona hujja e yimɓe ɓen.
